title: APPLESEED Example Dataset
description: This longitudinal EEG dataset comprises 48 recording sessions from 13 infants assessed at 4, 8, and 12 months of age, with test-retest reliability measurements at 4 months. The dataset was developed to validate APPLESEED, an automated preprocessing pipeline for estimating scale-wise entropy from pediatric EEG data, and serves as a reference resource for developmental cognitive neuroscience research. This dataset is part of a larger longitudinal study initially described in Puglia et al. (2020). The published version of the APPLESEED validation study is available in Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience (Puglia et al., 2022).
methods_description: Longitudinal EEG recordings were collected from infants at three developmental timepoints (4, 8, and 12 months of age). Test-retest reliability was assessed via two appointments within one week at the 4-month timepoint. Complete longitudinal data (sessions 1-4) were obtained from 11 infants (6 female), while 2 additional infants contributed reliability data only (sessions 1-2).
